assets.name: 朝の街路
assets.scene: A quiet cobblestone main street in a modest medieval fantasy frontier town, morning. On the left edge a modest family house with a wooden front door, low stone wall and open garden gate; the street leads gently toward an adventurers guild district. Timber framed plaster houses, terracotta roofs, a few potted plants, distant green hills. Welcoming lived-in town, not a royal capital. No people. Broad clear foreground pavement for overlay characters. The central third must read as a town street even in a portrait crop.

assets.name: ギルド執務室・昼
assets.scene: The master's office in an old but cared-for adventurers guild. Human-scale comfortable room, oak structural beams and cream plaster walls. A substantial old oak desk at the rear center with uneven stacks of parchment ledgers, inkpot and rolled maps, empty high-backed chair behind it, bookshelves along rear left wall. A tall arched window on rear right casts soft daylight; a worn forest-green upholstered nap sofa beneath the right window, clearly a place for an adult to lie down. Small brass-and-glass magical lamps, modest furnishings. Warm but burdened by paperwork, not ruined or palatial. Clear open floor in the foreground to overlay speaking characters; visible desk stays in central vertical third. No people.

A hearth on back left, a wooden bar at rear center, shelves of ceramic pitchers and wooden cups, barrels to rear right, warm brass lanterns and sunset light from a small window. Few sturdy communal tables kept at side edges, clear central foreground floor for dialogue character overlays, no large foreground table blocking characters. Cozy place for a successful expedition's celebration, human-scale rather than a huge banquet hall. No patrons, no people, no food closeup.
